$description: SortableList (platform/patterns/SortableList), library wave 10, lane A: its component tokens. Items on the default surface with the subtle frame and the control corners, a data row's height (it follows the density); while an item moves it takes the drag-and-drop treatment (the dnd tokens).

sortable-list-gap.$description: SortableList: the space between two items (the insertion line is drawn in it).

sortable-list-tile-min-width.$description: SortableList grid: a tile's least width; as many tiles as fit share a row.

sortable-list-item-border-color.$description: SortableList item: its frame (the subtle border).

sortable-list-item-radius.$description: SortableList item: its corners (the control radius).

sortable-list-item-gap.$description: SortableList item: the space between the handle, the content and the move buttons.

sortable-list-item-min-height.$description: SortableList item: its least height (a data row's: it follows the density).

sortable-list-item-padding-block.$description: SortableList item: the space above and below its content.

sortable-list-item-padding-inline.$description: SortableList item: the space at its start and end.

sortable-list-buttons-gap.$description: SortableList move buttons: the space between Move up and Move down.

sortable-list-item-dragging-background.$description: SortableList item while it moves (pointer or keyboard): the raised surface of the Dragged treatment.

sortable-list-item-dragging-shadow.$description: SortableList item while it moves: the overlay shadow of the Dragged treatment.

sortable-list-item-dragging-opacity.$description: SortableList item while it follows the pointer: a little transparent.

sortable-list-focus-outline-color.$description: SortableList item that drags as a whole, focused with the keyboard: the focus ring's color.

sortable-list-focus-outline-offset.$description: SortableList item focused: the focus ring's offset.

sortable-list-focus-outline-width.$description: SortableList item focused: the focus ring's width.
